scenes.headline: How one model indexes text, pictures, video and sound together
scenes.sub: Ovis-Embedding: Qwen2.5-Omni read as a single search index
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kombu! Here's how one model puts text, pictures, video and sound into a single search index.

scenes.text: Keep an omni-modal chat model's own encoders, drop its speech head, and read the last token's hidden state as the embedding.
scenes.say: Take a model that already reads all four in one transformer, drop its speech generator, and use the last token as the embedding.

steps.say: A caption with an instruction, a picture, a video or a sound clip can go in, alone or mixed.
Pictures and frames pass through the vision encoder, sound through the audio encoder.
Then one shared transformer, the Thinker, reads every token in one sequence.
The final hidden state of the last token is the embedding. No projection head, about two thousand numbers.

parts.note: p: the softmax share on the right match
parts.say: p is the softmax share on the right match, scored against the whole batch.

parts.note: focal weight: solved queries count for less
parts.say: The focal weight shrinks solved queries, so the hard ones get the budget.

items.say: Low-rank adapters first, on everything mixed.

items.text: Full finetune, one dataset per batch
items.say: Then the full model, one dataset per batch, so negatives differ in meaning.
Then distillation, aimed where the student still fails.
Last, a rotation and an adapter for shorter vectors.

steps.note: each micro-batch comes from one dataset
steps.say: The paper's own drawing: one dataset per micro-batch, and duplicates removed by hash.

scenes.title: MMEB-v3 overall, 190 tasks
scenes.note: WeMM is not in the paper; its 11 audio tasks count as zero.
scenes.say: It beats every model the paper compared. A nine billion parameter model it left out scores higher, with no audio at all.

scenes.text: An omni model's last token becomes a shared index with no new layers; the work is in batches, teachers and instructions.
scenes.say: No new layers needed: the batches, the teachers and the instructions do the work.

recap: The last token's hidden state is the vector
Four stages, from LoRA to shorter vectors
Strong overall; audio retrieval still weak
scenes.say: To recap: the last token is the vector, four stages shape it, and audio retrieval is still weak.
